text:
ryan.support: Urgent escalation from ZebraCorp — their SCIM provisioning started failing ~09:12 UTC, users not being created and they're seeing a billing spike. They say SSO logins work but SCIM calls return 403 during user create. Also customer claims audit logs don’t show key access for those requests. Can we triage? :rotating_light:

maria.security: @ryan.support can you paste a sample request id + time window and confirm if any KMS rotations happened in the last 24h for their key alias? Need to see whether KMS returned an error or if writes were blocked by policy.

ryan.support: Repro steps from customer:
1) SSO login ok
2) Provision via SCIM (POST /scim/v2/Users)
3) Provisioner returns 403 and client sees retries

Example log snippet they pasted:
```
2026-08-15T09:12:03Z INFO scim-provisioner request_id=01E9XJZ user=zebra.user@zc.com action=create
2026-08-15T09:12:03Z ERROR scim-provisioner request_id=01E9XJZ kms_error=AccessDenied: not authorized to Encrypt key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd
2026-08-15T09:12:04Z INFO scim-provisioner retry=1 request_id=01E9XJZ
```
They also say the control-plane audit UI shows no KMS Decrypt/Encrypt events for those times. Billing team says ~8k extra token ops in the window.

jeff.oncall: Likely gap between KMS policy and SCIM role. Check IAM role bound to scim-provisioner service — needs kms:Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey on that key. Also check the key policy if it was replaced by rotation job. Quick query to check for key-access events:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Encrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName=scim-provisioner
```
If that returns empty, key calls never reached KMS.

alex.devex: Also note SCIM uses a different codepath than SSO (we encrypt provisioning tokens with the customer key). SSO auth could still succeed while provisioning fails. Short mitigation: flip that customer's SCIM integration to use platform-managed key or disable retries on the webhook, so we don't keep burning token ops. Can we toggle to fallback key while infra investigates?

ops-liz: I can flip them to fallback key (platform-managed) temporarily and replay their pending provisioning queue if we get green. Need approval from security and confirmation from billing we won't double-charge. @maria.security ok to proceed?

billing-ops: Confirmed spike correlates with repeated 403-driven retries — estimated ~8k extra token generations and ~6000 failed provisioning attempts. If we toggle to fallback key and re-run once, we should credit the extra token ops. Need an owner and a CC list for the credit request.

scim-bot: Investigation ticket created: INC-2026-345, severity=P2, owner=unassigned. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-345

ryan.support: Providing artifacts: request_ids=[01E9XJZ, 01E9XK2], window=2026-08-15T09:10:00Z..2026-08-15T09:25:00Z, key_alias=alias/zebra-prod-key. Customer contact: erin@zebra.com. Please assign an owner and next steps.

maria.security: I'll own the security investigation. Immediate steps I will run:
- Check KMS key policy and rotation logs
- Pull audit trail for key alias for the given window (CloudTrail + internal audit store)
- Approve fallback to platform-managed key for temporary mitigation if ops-liz confirms no compliance block
I'll post timeline within 30m. @billing-ops please stash the credit request draft and I’ll attach final artifact after audit extraction. :white_check_mark:
